reasons: The claimed deviation is supported by the cited text: Section 5(a)-(d) contain only compliance, authority/rights and non-infringement reps, with no conformance warranty, warranty period, malicious-code warranty or remedy, while 5(e) disclaims implied warranties — leaving the customer near the 'AS IS' walk-away position.

The inserted subsection (f) reaches the preferred playbook position with a targeted addition: workmanlike standard, 12-month conformance for software/Works, 90-day conformance for Services, no-malicious-code warranty, and a re-perform/repair/replace-or-refund remedy; compliance with laws already exists in 5(a) so no duplication was needed.

The edit expressly states that Paragraph 5(e) does not limit or waive the new express warranties, satisfying the redline guidance to carve the express warranty out of the disclaimer; existing p0030 text is left intact (minimal edit).
Comment is accurate, correctly cites the playbook position, and offers the 90/30-day fallback with the same remedies; tone and prefix conform.

Minor, non-blocking: the new warranty is appended after the all-caps disclaimer rather than before it (drafting order/formatting), and the remedy makes refund a backstop after 30 days rather than a pure vendor-option — both are within the playbook's customer-side latitude.
